links.comparator_used: Other correction strategies in a six-strategy, seven-model subanalysis (permissive, alternatives, or expansion strategies versus conservative editing or abstention)
links.outcome: Intent drift (wrong message) in LLM-corrected simulated BCI text
links.effect: Conservative editing or abstention lowered drift, while alternatives or expansion raised it. No strategy eliminated drift, and even the best still produced a wrong message in 18 of 100 corrections. Per-strategy numbers are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: A separate subanalysis of six correction strategies (original seven-model panel) found no strategy removed drift: conservative editing or abstention lowered it, while alternatives or expansion raised it.

design_hint: correction strategy/prompt policy (conservative editing, abstention) and confidence-based gating
